notes.title: Beat The Behemoth LIVE on Stream Tomorrow!
notes.content:
This Friday, January 31, at 12:00 PM PST, The Behemoth wants YOU to challenge us at our own game. A customary competition at our tradeshows, we wanted to open up a special challenge for EVERYONE in celebration of BEHEMOTH’s Challenge Mode update! Join studio co-founders Dan Paladin and John “John Behemoth” Baez as we dodge, flap, and duck through the newly added Challenge Mode in BEHEMOTH!

We will be live on Twitch, YouTube, and Steam beginning at 12:00 PM PST competing against EVERYONE who is actively playing the ALL NEW Challenge Mode! Beat us and win a BEHEMOTH Klean Kanteen from our merch store. (+ maybe other goodies?!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270233/15827c8f929905a21ae9a8aabea8960299b5c3bd.png
Rules:

 You have to beat our final score while we’re live on-air.
 Any pre-existing scores on the leaderboard before our first entry will not be counted, since you have to beat us while we’re live.
 In the event that multiple people beat us, highest score wins! As long as you beat us while we’re live.
 No cheating. We’ll know. We always know. We will know if you don’t beat us while we’re live, too.
 No NSFW usernames – if you have to ask if your username is inappropriate, it most likely is.

Upon ending our runs, and in between runs, we will go to the main menu to check the Challenge Mode Leaderboard. If you have bested our high score during the stream, we will announce your username(s). If your username is called, it is up to YOU to email us at games@thebehemoth.com with screenshot proof of the leaderboard to prove the account belongs to you in order to claim your prize.

Note: please do not send us any potentially sensitive account info – an in-game screenshot of your name in the leaderboards will suffice as it will be specially highlighted.

You will need to contact us via email in order to ensure that:

 Your email address and shipping address is not shared in our chat (please don’t do this).
 You can include the screenshot to prove your sweet, sweet victory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270233/13382188f18c50d374d7da5a32f3207d910e7b58.gif
See you tomorrow!!!

notes.title: BEHEMOTH achievements are here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270233/c24daf0d408ffd8b7f445e636414374757098382.png

The first patch to BEHEMOTH is here, with 33 achievements, a couple of tweaks to gameplay, and some quick bug fixes!

Updates:

[olist]
 Features – 33 achievements have been added!
 Gameplay – Removed small increase of speed per checkpoint
 Gameplay – Decreased fork speed
[/olist]
Fixes:
[olist]
 Art – Fixed a couple of chicken cosmetic items
 Audio – Fixed a bug where the sunflower seed blocker SFX occasionally continues to play after the powerup is gone
 Audio – Adjustments have been made to the cockadoodledoo-nimals
[/olist]
What’s next for this chicken game?

Last week, we teased a new challenge mode in BEHEMOTH, where colliding with any eggshell, knife, or hatchet means instant death! Or in the chicken’s case, instant chicken dinner…

We ran a poll on our YouTube channel asking if you wanted this mode added to the game, and 93% of you chicken gamers voted yes! Sooooo next up, we’ll be working on implementing this game mode in BEHEMOTH, in addition to possibly adding a much chiller, no death, only FLYING mode. The more we think about it, the chicken probably deserves a moment of respite after all this chaos.

No thoughts, no cares, only BEHEMOTH.

notes.title: BEHEMOTH is Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:

We're here with some short but sweet good news: BEHEMOTH is now officially Steam Deck Verified! We have secured the Green Circular Checkmark and are certain that this will help us dodge eggshells better.

notes.title: BEHEMOTH is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Happy BEHEMOTH launch day!
Oh, and it’s HALLOWEEN, too! May we celebrate chickens together on Halloween (and every day) until the end of time!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270233/95a522b19b5f45671cce3c417990281ca18930a6.png

BEHEMOTH is now live on Steam with a 10% off launch discount! It’s time to become THE chicken, dodge n’ flap your way through the skies, secure your flock in the nest, and collect as much candy corn as chickenly possible! 

[previewyoutube=DdNI1jJDU20;full][/previewyoutube]

One last thing before you start your newfound chicken adventure – thank you. BEHEMOTH is a celebration of making indie games for the past 21 years, and we couldn’t have done it without your support. From our start in pioneering the flash-to-console scene with Alien Hominid to crashing castles with our best friends, escaping a theater run by cats, and helping Horatio save his son – it's been quite the wild ride since 2003! Consider this title a love letter to you, the community who has made it all possible. Our little (big) chicken hearts are overflowing with gratitude. BAAAAAAAWWK!

Now, it’s time. Go the distance and test your hen-durance! Customize your chicken to be as cute or cursed as you desire. Fly to the top of those daily BEHEMOTH leaderboards! We believe in you, and your little chicken wings.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027260/BEHEMOTH/

notes.title: Game 6 Announced and Launching in a Week! WHAAAT?!?!?!?!?
notes.content:
Chick-or-treat! 

Today, we have a special announcement from The Behemoth team! But first, we want to say thank you to YOU! From our start in pioneering the flash-to-console scene with Alien Hominid to crashing castles with our best friends, escaping a theater run by cats, and helping Horatio reclaim his blueberry farm – it’s been quite the wild ride since 2003! We couldn’t have made it through these past 21 years without your support. Thank you so much for being a part of this big chicken’s journey!

Now, about that special announcement. Drum roll, please… Introducing BEHEMOTH, a brand-new arcade extravaganza, releasing next Thursday, October 31st on Steam! Perfect to pick up for a run or two (or fifty), BEHEMOTH will finally allow you to become the iconic chicken mascot as you fly your flock of baby chicks to safety while dodging deadly fruits and peck-uliar obstacles soaring through the sky!

[previewyoutube=6oHnqCBELU8;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6oHnqCBELU8[/previewyoutube]
Chicken Game Features:

🥚 Soar across the sky, gather baby chicks, and secure your flock to increase your score!

🥚 Collect mounds of candy corn to unlock tons of new cosmetics like chicken colors, beaks, wattles, and feet!

🥚 Utilize Very Powerful Power-ups™ to assist in your journey

🥚 Compete in daily leaderboards for highest score and most checkpoints secured

🥚 Customize your chicken to be as cute or cursed as you desire…

🥚 Have the most fun you’ve ever had in your entire life***

Price: $3.99 (with a 10% launch discount!!)
Single-player

***as long as you manage your eggs-pectations

Do you have what it takes to fly to the top of the BEHEMOTH daily leaderboards??? Are you confident in dodging deadly melons and comically large forks???! Well, you have until next Thursday to mentally prepare for this peck-uliar challenge, and you can start by adding the game to your Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027260/BEHEMOTH/
